ARCS kitMolecule 64kintsugi-seam

Kintsugi Seam

Show a break in the work visibly, with what broke, how it was found, the repair and the guard that stops it recurring, joined to the next seam by a gold line.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1Seam lineA 1px gold rule between seams: the repaired break (ROM primitive 6, Kintsugi)gold
2KeySeam id and when it was found, mono, sentence case, goldgold
3RowsA dl: Break, Found, Repair, Guard; the term in a 6rem column from a 30rem containertext-secondary, text

Usage

Use it when

  • The work broke and was repaired, and the reader should see the break, not a silent patch.
  • A doubt was raised and withdrawn: the withdrawal is a seam too.

Do not use it when

  • Do not hide a break in prose; every break gets all four rows, with Repair saying Not applied when it was not.
  • Gold here is the repair seam, a limit that was hit; do not use the seam gold for decoration.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
seams[]{key, break, found, repair, guard}yesrepair names what was done or says Not applied.

Access

  • Each seam is a definition list, so a screen reader pairs Break, Found, Repair and Guard with their text.
  • The gold line is decoration over a structure that already separates the seams.
